hits.title: Realtime Robotics names Kevin Carlin Chief Executive Officer to lead company's next phase of growth.
hits.snippet: Realtime Robotics, the leader in industrial AI for automated robot system design and deployment, today announced that Kevin Carlin has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately.

hits.title: Thanks for helping us close out a successful Robotics Tech Week!
hits.snippet: Last Thursday Realtime Robotics, Inc. had the pleasure of closing out a successful Robotics Tech Week 2025 by hosting an office tour, complete with a demo of its latest innovation - Resolver - a cloud-based optimization engine that automates the most time- and labor-intensive parts of robotic workcell design, including path planning, task allocation, sequencing, and layout validation.
